data.text: The role of the sepal is to protect the bud before it blooms into a flower.
The petals are the brightest part of the flower.
Petals attract insects towards the flower.
The male parts of the flower are the anther and the filament. Together they make up the stamen.
The anther is covered in pollen.
The female part of the plant is called the pistil.
Petals attract the insects towards the plant.
